**How to falsify it:** If mutations in ALG8 are found to be exclusively associated with ALG8-CDG and do not show any correlation with polycystic liver disease, or if a distinct and unrelated molecular pathway is identified as the primary driver of polycystic liver disease independently of glycosylation defects. _(variant: Presence of common loss-of-function variants in ALG8 in the general population (gnomAD > 1%) would falsify its role as a rare disease gene for either condition.)_
